title: useMultiSelect Hook
description:
Implement a `useMultiSelect` hook that returns `{ selected, toggle, selectAll, clear, isSelected }`. `selected` is a `Set`. `toggle(item)` adds if absent, removes if present. `selectAll(items)` selects all given items. `isSelected(item)` returns a boolean.

**Example:**
```tsx
const { selected, toggle, selectAll, clear, isSelected } = useMultiSelect([]);
```
ai_context: Common mistake: calling isSelected by looking up selected.has(item) inside a stale closure — make sure isSelected reads from the current selected state, not a captured variable from an earlier render.
